### TAG-100: Define the runtime concurrency interface (platform-agnostic)

## Software Notes

Specify the abstract interface the IL runtime needs from any host OS: theng/place storage, completeness signaling (NULL→DATA transitions), task/thread spawn for invocations, and inter-place message passing. This is the contract both the POSIX and NuttX backends implement — write it before either backend exists.

One thing worth flagging as you file these: this issue is load-bearing for everything else, so it might be worth treating it with extra care — maybe even its own short design doc/issue description with the Reference-section convention we just worked out, since "what exactly is the interface" is the one decision that's expensive to get wrong after #2 and #7 both depend on it.
